name: es30-buffer-mapping
title: Buffer mapping and copying
summary: glMapBufferRange with all six access flags (every one of the 64 combinations checked against the spec's rule table), glFlushMappedBufferRange with relative sub-ranges, glUnmapBuffer, mapped-state queries in 32 and 64 bits, glGetBufferPointerv and glCopyBufferSubData, with every defined error; buffer contents verified byte for byte through MAP_READ_BIT mappings (only bytes the spec defines) and by drawing from the buffers.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.10.1 Creating and Binding Buffer Objects (zero-bound targets, deletion)
ES 3.0 §2.10.2 Creating Buffer Object Data Stores (BufferData unmaps, BufferSubData on a mapped range), Table 2.8
ES 3.0 §2.10.3 Mapping and Unmapping Buffer Data (access flags, FlushMappedBufferRange, §2.10.3.1 UnmapBuffer, §2.10.3.2), Table 2.9
ES 3.0 §6.1.9 Buffer Object Queries (GetBufferParameteri[64]v, GetBufferPointerv), Table 2.7
ES 3.0 §2.5 GL Errors, §2.9.3 Drawing Commands, §3.6.1 Basic Polygon Rasterization

api.glMapBufferRange: pointer returned and written/read: bytes compared with a CPU copy; all 64 flag combinations vs the spec's INVALID_OPERATION table; length 0 / negative / out-of-range / already mapped / zero-bound -> NULL + the defined error
api.glUnmapBuffer: returns TRUE after every valid mapping; on an unmapped or zero-bound buffer INVALID_OPERATION (return value FALSE checked, XFAIL on radeonsi glthread)
api.glFlushMappedBufferRange: flushed sub-ranges (relative to the mapping start) arrive byte for byte; unflushed ranges are never asserted; negative / out-of-mapping / unmapped / non-FLUSH_EXPLICIT / zero-bound -> the defined errors
api.glCopyBufferSubData: COPY_READ -> COPY_WRITE and within one buffer (adjacent ranges): exact bytes and pixels; overlap, out of range, negative, mapped, zero-bound -> INVALID_VALUE / INVALID_OPERATION and the destination is unchanged
api.glGetBufferParameteriv: BUFFER_MAPPED, BUFFER_ACCESS_FLAGS, BUFFER_MAP_OFFSET, BUFFER_MAP_LENGTH, BUFFER_SIZE after every valid flag combination and after unmapping (Table 2.8 values); zero-bound target -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glGetBufferParameteri64v: BUFFER_SIZE, BUFFER_MAP_OFFSET, BUFFER_MAP_LENGTH equal the 32-bit values for all 19 valid flag combinations
api.glGetBufferPointerv: BUFFER_MAP_POINTER equals the pointer glMapBufferRange returned, NULL when unmapped and after BufferData; same through a second binding of the buffer
api.glBufferData: initial data observed by mapping and by drawing; NULL data allowed; re-specification of a mapped buffer unmaps it (state back to Table 2.8)
api.glBufferSubData: INVALID_OPERATION over a mapped range and nothing written; works again after unmapping (bytes compared)
api.glBindBuffer: ARRAY_BUFFER / COPY_READ_BUFFER / COPY_WRITE_BUFFER bindings: mapping through any target, state seen through the others
api.glDeleteBuffers: deleting a mapped buffer is not an error, resets the binding to 0
api.glIsBuffer: FALSE after deleting a mapped buffer
api.glGetIntegerv: ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING untouched by copies; COPY_READ/WRITE_BUFFER_BINDING name the copy buffers
api.glVertexAttribPointer: position (float x2) and color (normalized unsigned byte x4) read from the mapped-and-written buffers; observed through pixels
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: both attributes sourced from the buffers
api.glGenVertexArrays: VAO used for the validated draws
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLES from sub-ranges (first/count) of the buffers: every quad's color probed in 16 cells
api.glUniform2f: u_shift moves a draw of buffer data; the shifted copies appear at the expected cell positions
api.glUseProgram: program used for the validated draws
api.glViewport: per-cell viewports map NDC to the probed pixels
api.glScissor: per-cell clear (cell interior vs grid lines)
api.glDisable: DITHER disabled so colors are exact; SCISSOR_TEST restored
api.glClearColor: background pixels equal the clear color
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, also per cell through the scissor
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of 23 probes per cell

visual_review.notes: Viewed gpu es-max and llvmpipe es-min captures (256x256, identical): 4x4 grid of cells separated by 2-px lighter grid lines on a dark-blue background; every cell shows a 2x2 arrangement of four flat-colored quads. Cell 0 red/green over blue/yellow; cell 1 cyan/magenta over orange/white; cell 2 inverted colors (blue, red, green, tan); cell 3 dark slate and teal in the corners with yellow/green in between; cell 5 has an empty top-left slot (quad 2 not flushed, not drawn); cell 8 repeats its bottom row on top; cell 12 shows only quads 1 and 2 (top-left yellow, bottom-right blue) with the other two slots empty; cell 14 shows blue/orange over magenta/yellow after the mapped-draw experiment was cleared. No stray marks.
